description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'TatweejAudioPlayer' which manages audio playback for Tatweej words using an ExoPlayer instance. It handles initializing the player, preloading audio items, managing playback state, responding to user interactions like tapping words, and releasing resources.

classes.name: TatweejAudioPlayer
classes.description: Helper class for audio playback of Tatweej words, managing a single ExoPlayer instance and providing methods to preload, control, and stop playback.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Prepares the player with a list of Tatweej words and warms up the first item to reduce latency.

methods.name: setOnStateListener
methods.description: Sets a callback function to listen for UI state changes such as playing index and buffering status.

methods.name: onWordTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a word; restarts the current word if tapped again or switches to a new word.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and clears UI state related to playing.

methods.name: emitState
methods.description: Internal method to invoke the UI state callback with current playback status.

methods.name: mediaItemFor
methods.description: Creates a MediaItem object for a given TatweejWord based on its audio resource ID.
